label: Asset Data Pipeline - Energy Hourly
info: Reads hourly energy REST API, maps it to asset_id format, writes normalized samples to backend data pipeline, and stores normalized samples in flow/global cache for verification flow. Verification flow reads assetSamples:<assetId> and does not know the datasource.

label: VRE Verification Only - Asset Cache
info: Verification-only flow. Reads recommendation.fields.recommendation.verification.rules[].assetId and loads prepared samples from assetSamples:{assetId}. No REST/MQTT/OPCUA/MODBUS datasource mapping here.
